# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class EquityChandelierExitAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True
        self._equity = self.add_equity("SPY")
        self._chandelier_exit = self.chandelier_exit(self._equity, 20, 6.5, Resolution.DAILY)
        # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
        # self._chandelier_exit = ChandelierExit(20, 6.5)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._equity, self._chandelier_exit, Resolution.DAILY)
        # self.register_indicator(self._equity, self._chandelier_exit, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.plot_indicator("SPY", self._chandelier_exit)

    def on_data(self, data: Slice) -> None:
        if not self._chandelier_exit.is_ready:
            return
        price = self._equity.price
        stop_loss = self._chandelier_exit.stop_loss
        if not self._equity.invested and price > stop_loss:
            self.set_holdings(self._equity, 1)
        elif self._equity.invested and price < stop_loss:
            self.liquidate()
